verdict.rationale: Braintrust's tracing docs describe recording inputs, outputs, model parameters, latency, token usage and metadata. Nothing in the pack mentions images, audio, file attachments or other multimodal payloads in traces. Multimodal capture is a fair axis for an LLM observability platform, so the missing evidence yields none, not na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture multimodal payloads (images, audio, files) inside my traces
